Olivia Reyes: thinking out loud — propose we add proxy-level split-steering as an intermediate active/active strategy. idea: route reads probabilistically to nearest region but enforce X-geo-consent for PII writes. want to avoid full escrow/lease complexity for short term. thoughts?
Harish Patel: love the idea. main q: how do we guarantee write finality if a user hits non-resident region due to prob steering? fallback plan?
Mei Chen: agree it's lighter weight. suggestion: require resident-region header for any write with sensitive scopes and return 412 if mismatch. then client retries to resident endpoint. less operator work than leases.
Tomas Viklund: +1. add metrics: count of 412s and retry latency. also how to opt-in tenants that require strict residency? config flag per-tenant.
Olivia Reyes: rough proxy header example:
```
X-Resident-Region: eu
X-Consent-Flags: pii=required
```
Proxy checks, if not matching -> respond 412 + Retry-Region hint.
Mei Chen: what about cached embeddings/kv? read-after-write consistency could break if reads go to other region while write still replicating.
Harish Patel: we should do short synchronous replication for small objects (tokens, profile meta) and async for big stuff. fallback: for strong-consistency tenants, proxy pins to resident until replication confirmed.
Tomas Viklund: rollout plan: feature-flagged proxy, 10% traffic global, use canary tenant set with consent=true, collect SLO regressions. infra-bot can help with automatic rollback.
infra-bot: deploy job started: canary/proxy-split-steer v1 -> infra/prod/cluster-a
Olivia Reyes: question: how to represent tenant policy? store as tenant config (residency_required: ["eu"] or residency_mode: strict|flex). simple string list.
Mei Chen: also need a graceful error map for clients. 412 -> { retry_region: "eu", ttl_seconds: 30 }
Harish Patel: for billing/metrics, tag tokens served via fallback to measure cost delta. important for Customer Success conversations.
Tomas Viklund: security: add audit log entry when proxy routes away from resident region for non-strict tenants. keep privacy team happy.
Olivia Reyes: ok next steps: write tiny RFC PR with interfaces: proxy header, tenant flag, error payload. Tomas + Mei to sketch rollout playbook. Harish to list replication categories (sync/async). I'll open PR.
Mei Chen: ack — will add priming cache note (avoid stale reads during cutover).
Harish Patel: ack.
Tomas Viklund: ack. :rocket:
